reviews.title: Works immediately, happy
reviews.comment:
It is ram. I purchased this for my Victus 15L prebuilt. The number of ram in it has gone up, as well as my joy. Two other products that arrived with this were faulty and needed return -- this ram? Functional. Beautiful. Proper, fit, fantastic. I love this ram. And it's cute.
I needed this victory today.
reviews.author: Emily
